instruction.name: vreplve.b
instruction.description: Repeat the element in lane `idx` (index modulo 16) of `a` to fill whole vector.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplve.b $vr0, $vr8, $r4; vreplve.b $vr1, $vr9, $r5; vreplve.b $vr2, $vr10, $r6; vreplve.b $vr3, $vr11, $r7; vreplve.b $vr4, $vr12, $r8; vreplve.b $vr5, $vr13, $r9; vreplve.b $vr6, $vr14, $r10; vreplve.b $vr7, $vr15, $r11
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 0; li.d $r6, 0; li.d $r7, 0; li.d $r8, 0; li.d $r9, 0; li.d $r10, 0; li.d $r11, 0' --asm 'vreplve.b $vr0, $vr8, $r4; vreplve.b $vr1, $vr9, $r5; vreplve.b $vr2, $vr10, $r6; vreplve.b $vr3, $vr11, $r7; vreplve.b $vr4, $vr12, $r8; vreplve.b $vr5, $vr13, $r9; vreplve.b $vr6, $vr14, $r10; vreplve.b $vr7, $vr15, $r11'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
